description: A profile of any domain the answer engines cite: how often our measurements saw engines read it and across how many businesses and categories, what the site says it is (title and description from our crawl of its homepage), the co-read pack it travels in (sources the engines read together), and, where our crawler found one, the page where a business gets listed on it. Aggregate market data from our measurement corpus; a thin result means the engines rarely cite it in what we have measured so far.

source.description: The source domain, e.g. canstar.com.au or yelp.com

name: get_source_profile
title: What a cited source is and how to get on it
